name: F2-A 05-consent - Figma-text fixture
expectedStrings: Choose each consent separately. Nothing is recorded until you save.
residualNotes: Test-only Figma-like sample copy. Removed signature pad, prefilled signature, Recorded badge, EST timestamp, PDF/road-test/data-storage consents (not in the model). Kept PROCESSING and PUBLIC_LINK only; both start unselected and no record exists until Save. Consent types are explicit selectable cards plus Granted/Refused choices (three states) rather than the Figma switches. Third consent card and signature block are the largest residuals.
